source: Suprcode/Zircon Client controls and GameScene views
purpose: Explicit rendering policy for every DX control type currently discovered in the complete GameScene UI source manifest.

DXLabel.visual: runtime text overlay; not baked into source PNG

DXButton.visual: source image when specified; otherwise generated from Interface.Zl button pieces

DXItemCell.visual: 36x36 Zircon item cell; runtime item contents remain dynamic

DXItemGrid.visual: 36x36 cell grid using Zircon cell geometry

DXControl.visual: draw only when source properties request background/border; otherwise pass-through

DXTextBox.visual: black field + Zircon primary border; text remains runtime

DXAnimatedControl.visual: source LibraryFile/Index base frame; animation remains runtime

DXTabControl.visual: container only; its DXTab buttons provide visible chrome

DXComboBox.visual: bordered field + GameInter 795 arrow; dropdown rows remain runtime

DXConfigTab.visual: same tab chrome policy as DXTab

DXNumberBox.visual: number field using text-box control treatment

DXListBox.visual: bordered list area + Zircon vertical scrollbar; rows remain runtime

DXKeyBindWindow.visual: do not draw as an inline child; it is separately opened at runtime

DXNumberTextBox.visual: numeric text field using text-box control treatment

DXTreeControl.visual: tree viewport + Interface 59-62 scrollbar; rows remain runtime
